title: Enforce authorization in controllers, views, jobs and API boundaries
summary: Applied explicit permission declarations to every tenant controller action, actor-bound domain authorization proofs, fail-closed UI hints, bounded JSON denial contracts, execution-time job reauthorization policies, a governed route/domain/job inventory and automated coverage checks.

risks: No migrations. Domain authorization proofs are internal immutable decisions and remain intentionally omitted from public API payloads; future tenant controllers and jobs must be added to the checked inventory.
next_steps: Prompt 033 can add role-management workflows on top of the enforced authorization boundary.
